5. Influenza

- More severe presentation
- RULED OUT due to lack of systemic symptoms

The pattern of symptoms (isolated throat pain without systemic symptoms or voice changes) is most consistent with viral pharyngitis. The mild intensity and lack of associated symptoms makes this the most likely diagnosis.
